s0101.literal: On wushen day the Shandong transport commission was changed to the chief transport commission, concurrently administering Ji'nan Circuit's wine tax and vinegar levy.
s0101.idiomatic: On wushen day the Shandong transport commission was changed to the chief transport commission, concurrently administering Ji'nan Circuit's wine tax and vinegar levy.

s0102.literal: On jiyou day hail as large as chicken eggs struck the Xu and Pi garrison farms and the Lingbi and Suining garrison colonies, damaging the wheat.
s0102.idiomatic: On jiyou day hail as large as chicken eggs struck the Xu and Pi garrison farms and the Lingbi and Suining garrison colonies, damaging the wheat.

s0103.literal: On jiayin day more than ten thousand bandits of Xun Prefecture raided Zhangpu; two thousand bandits of Quanzhou raided Changtai, Ting, and Gan; more than one thousand She bandits raided Longxi; all were suppressed.
s0103.idiomatic: On jiayin day more than 10,000 bandits of Xun Prefecture raided Zhangpu; 2,000 bandits of Quanzhou raided Changtai, Ting, and Gan; more than 1,000 She bandits raided Longxi; all were suppressed.

s0104.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingchen day Lai County and Putai suffered drought and famine; grain was released at reduced prices to relieve them.
s0104.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on bingchen day Lai County and Putai suffered drought and famine; grain was released at reduced prices to relieve them.

s0105.literal: On wuwu day the moon encroached upon the Well.
s0105.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon encroached upon the Well.

s0106.literal: On gengshen day, because Wugang and Baoqing circuits had repeatedly suffered bandit disorder, this year's wine tax levies and previous years' overdue rents were remitted.
s0106.idiomatic: On gengshen day, because Wugang and Baoqing circuits had repeatedly suffered bandit disorder, this year's wine tax levies and previous years' overdue rents were remitted.

s0107.literal: On xinyou day, following the request of the Quanzhou Branch Secretariat's Shabudin and Umar, pacification offices, a sea-ship myriarch office, and a maritime trade supervisorate were established.
s0107.idiomatic: On xinyou day, following the request of the Quanzhou branch secretariat's Shabudin and Umar, pacification offices, a sea-ship myriarch office, and a maritime trade supervisorate were established.

s0108.literal: The Pingyang princely household general administration office was abolished and merged into Pingyang Circuit; the miscellaneous manufacture supervisorate was merged into the miscellaneous manufacture general administration office.
s0108.idiomatic: The Pingyang princely household general administration office was abolished and merged into Pingyang Circuit; the miscellaneous manufacture supervisorate was merged into the miscellaneous manufacture general administration office.

s0109.literal: Sangge said: "Since the Yingchang equitable-purchase office was established in the bingzi year of Zhiyuan, there must have been much fraud and embezzlement; an audit should be intensified.
s0109.idiomatic: Sangge said, "Since the Yingchang equitable-purchase office was established in the bingzi year of Zhiyuan, there must have been much fraud and embezzlement; an audit should be intensified.

s0110.literal: Members of the imperial retinue hold extremely large tracts of land; rent should be levied acre by acre according to the military relay-station precedent, exempting four qing.
s0110.idiomatic: Members of the imperial retinue hold extremely large tracts of land; rent should be levied acre by acre according to the military relay-station precedent, exempting four qing.

s0112.literal: On guihai day the Hun River broke its banks; troops were dispatched to build dikes to hold it back.
s0112.idiomatic: On guihai day the Hun River broke its banks; troops were dispatched to build dikes to hold it back.

s0113.literal: On yichou day seven bandits of Guangdong including Dong Xianju all styled themselves Great Elder, gathered crowds and rebelled, and plundered the prefectures of Ji, Gan, Rui, Fu, Longxing, Nan'an, Shao, Xiong, and Ting. Attacks over successive years could not pacify them. Yuedimishi, vice director of the Jiangxi branch privy council, requested reinforcements; Hudutemur, Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor, also spoke of the wide territory and few troops. An edict ordered the Jiang-Huai province to detach one ten-thousand-household army to Jiangxi, to return to garrison after the bandits were pacified.
s0113.idiomatic: On yichou day seven bandits of Guangdong including Dong Xianju all styled themselves Great Elder, gathered crowds and rebelled, and plundered Ji, Gan, Rui, Fu, Longxing, Nan'an, Shao, Xiong, and Ting prefectures. Attacks over successive years could not pacify them. Yuedimishi, vice director of the Jiangxi branch privy council, requested reinforcements; Hudutemur, Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor, also spoke of the wide territory and few troops. An edict ordered the Jiang-Huai province to detach one ten-thousand-household army to Jiangxi, to return to garrison after the bandits were pacified.

s0114.literal: On wuchen day the Qielie River was dredged to irrigate civilian fields at Yellow Earth Mountain, Kouwennao'er.
s0114.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Qielie River was dredged to irrigate civilian fields at Yellow Earth Mountain, Kouwennao'er.

s0115.literal: On gengwu day a Hongjila relay station was established.
s0115.idiomatic: On gengwu day a Hongjila relay station was established.

s0116.literal: On guiyou day ministry secretariat officials said: "Recently, because Jiang-Huai suffered famine, branch secretariats were ordered to provide relief; officials and wealthy men took advantage to commit fraud, and much aid did not reach the poor.
s0116.idiomatic: On guiyou day ministry secretariat officials said, "Recently, because Jiang-Huai suffered famine, branch secretariats were ordered to provide relief; officials and wealthy men took advantage to commit fraud, and much aid did not reach the poor.

s0117.literal: Now Hang, Su, Hu, and Xiu four prefectures again suffered great floods; people sold wives and daughters to buy food. We request that two hundred thousand shi of tribute rice be diverted and distributed to those verified as poor.
s0117.idiomatic: Now Hang, Su, Hu, and Xiu four prefectures again suffered great floods; people sold wives and daughters to buy food. We request that 200,000 shi of tribute rice be diverted and distributed to those verified as poor.

s0119.literal: On jiaxu day Wan'an Temple was completed; Buddha images and window walls were all gilded, costing five hundred forty odd liang of gold and two hundred forty jin of mercury in all.
s0119.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Wan'an Temple was completed; Buddha images and window walls were all gilded, costing 540 odd liang of gold and 240 jin of mercury in all.

s0120.literal: Newly submitted troops of Liaoyang province who had fled back to their various guards were ordered to assist in constructing the ministry secretariat, and were still commanded to be gathered back along separate routes.
s0120.idiomatic: Newly submitted troops of Liaoyang province who had fled back to their various guards were ordered to assist in constructing the ministry secretariat, and were still commanded to be gathered back along separate routes.

s0121.literal: Additional sea-transport grain granaries were established at Zhigu.
s0121.idiomatic: Additional sea-transport grain granaries were established at Zhigu.

s0122.literal: Troops on the Jiaozhi campaign were ordered home for one year's rest.
s0122.idiomatic: Troops on the Jiaozhi campaign were ordered home for one year's rest.

s0123.literal: An edict to the Burma branch secretariat: when you arrive in Burma, everything is to obey the Prince of Yunnan's command.
s0123.idiomatic: An edict to the Burma branch secretariat: when you arrive in Burma, everything is to obey the Prince of Yunnan's command.

s0124.literal: On gengchen day Annam King Ri Xuan dispatched Central Grandee Chen Keyong to present local products as tribute.
s0124.idiomatic: On gengchen day Annam King Ri Xuan dispatched Central Grandee Chen Keyong to present local products as tribute.

s0125.literal: Prince Xiaoxue was granted one hundred liang of gold, ten thousand liang of silver, one thousand ingots of notes, and silks and cloths in graded amounts.
s0125.idiomatic: Prince Xiaoxue received 100 liang of gold, 10,000 liang of silver, 1,000 ingots of notes, and silks and cloths in graded amounts.

s0126.literal: On xinsi day Prince Achiji was granted two hundred liang of gold, twenty-two thousand five hundred liang of silver, nine thousand ingots of notes, and gauze, silk, and cloth in graded amounts.
s0126.idiomatic: On xinsi day Prince Achiji received 200 liang of gold, 22,500 liang of silver, 9,000 ingots of notes, and gauze, silk, and cloth in graded amounts.

s0127.literal: The Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch three hundred newly submitted troops to garrison-farm at Ejinay; Shaanxi province was ordered to supervise five thousand Gongchang troops to garrison-farm at Liupanshan.
s0127.idiomatic: The Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch 300 newly submitted troops to garrison-farm at Ejinay; Shaanxi province was ordered to supervise 5,000 Gongchang troops to garrison-farm at Liupanshan.

s0128.literal: On guiwei day Yunnan branch secretariat right vice director Ailu memorialized: "Since setting out from Zhongqing, passing through Luoluo and Baiyi to enter Jiaozhi, we fought thirty-eight battles going and returning; heads cut off are beyond counting; officers and soldiers from commander-in-chief downward who earned merit number four hundred seventy-four.
s0128.idiomatic: On guiwei day Yunnan branch secretariat right vice director Ailu memorialized, "Since setting out from Zhongqing, passing through Luoluo and Baiyi to enter Jiaozhi, we fought 38 battles going and returning; heads cut off are beyond counting; officers and soldiers from commander-in-chief downward who earned merit number 474.

s0129.literal: " On jiashen day an edict ordered the imperial grandson to lead the armies in suppressing the rebel princes Huoluhuosun and Heddan Tulugan.
s0129.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict ordered the imperial grandson to lead the armies in suppressing the rebel princes Huoluhuosun and Heddan Tulugan.

s0130.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day Wuping Circuit was commanded to muster one thousand horses.
s0130.idiomatic: Fifth month, on bingxu day Wuping Circuit was commanded to muster 1,000 horses.

s0131.literal: On wuzi day Prince Chagha's son Kuokuodai rebelled; Chuangwu'er seized him and brought him in.
s0131.idiomatic: On wuzi day Prince Chagha's son Kuokuodai rebelled; Chuangwu'er seized him and brought him in.

s0132.literal: On jichou day Bianliang suffered torrential rain; the river broke its banks at Xiangyi, washing away wheat and millet.
s0132.idiomatic: On jichou day Bianliang suffered torrential rain; the river broke its banks at Xiangyi, washing away wheat and millet.

s0133.literal: Left and right keshig guards together with five thousand three hundred Han troops followed the imperial grandson on the northern campaign.
s0133.idiomatic: Left and right keshig guards together with 5,300 Han troops followed the imperial grandson on the northern campaign.

s0134.literal: On jiawu day five thousand Han troops of the five guards were dispatched on the northern campaign.
s0134.idiomatic: On jiawu day 5,000 Han troops of the five guards were dispatched on the northern campaign.

s0135.literal: On yiwei day Sangge said: "Zhongtong notes have circulated nearly thirty years; provincial officials do not know their numbers. Now that Zhiyuan notes have replaced them, officials should be dispatched by separate routes to establish offices and audit Zhongtong note reserves.
s0135.idiomatic: On yiwei day Sangge said, "Zhongtong notes have circulated nearly thirty years; provincial officials do not know their numbers. Now that Zhiyuan notes have replaced them, officials should be dispatched by separate routes to establish offices and audit Zhongtong note reserves.

s0137.literal: On bingshen day Prince Baba was granted one hundred liang of gold, ten thousand liang of silver, five hundred bolts of plain gold silk, and four thousand five hundred of gauze, silk, and cloth.
s0137.idiomatic: On bingshen day Prince Baba received 100 liang of gold, 10,000 liang of silver, 500 bolts of plain gold silk, and 4,500 of gauze, silk, and cloth.

s0139.literal: On dingyou day Pingjiang's waters subsided; wine taxes owed were remitted.
s0139.idiomatic: On dingyou day Pingjiang's waters subsided; wine taxes owed were remitted.

s0140.literal: Grain prices were reduced to relieve the capital.
s0140.idiomatic: Grain prices were reduced to relieve the capital.

s0141.literal: Yunnan's Wusa pacification commission was changed to a pacification commission, concurrently administering the military myriarch office.
s0141.idiomatic: Yunnan's Wusa pacification commission was changed to a pacification commission, concurrently administering the military myriarch office.

s0142.literal: On wuxu day the Luzhaitai, Yuezhi, and Sanchagou three salt offices were restored.
s0142.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Luzhaitai, Yuezhi, and Sanchagou three salt offices were restored.

s0143.literal: Wang Jianu, Huoluhudai, and Chaghan again raised troops in rebellion.
s0143.idiomatic: Wang Jianu, Huoluhudai, and Chaghan again raised troops in rebellion.

s0144.literal: On jihai day the Yunnan branch secretariat said: "The five cities west of the Jinsha River including Tong'an should remain under Chaghanzhang Pacification Commission as before; the five places east of the Jinsha River including Yongning should be abolished; Beisheng Shi Prefecture should become Beisheng Prefecture.
s0144.idiomatic: On jihai day the Yunnan branch secretariat said, "The five cities west of the Jinsha River including Tong'an should remain under Chaghanzhang Pacification Commission as before; the five places east of the Jinsha River including Yongning should be abolished; Beisheng Shi Prefecture should become Beisheng Prefecture.

s0146.literal: On renyin day the armillary sphere was completed.
s0146.idiomatic: On renyin day the armillary sphere was completed.

s0147.literal: One hundred fifty thousand shi of rice was transported to Yizhou to supply the army and relieve famine-stricken people.
s0147.idiomatic: 150,000 shi of rice was transported to Yizhou to supply the army and relieve famine-stricken people.

s0148.literal: On yisi day the Xingzhou honey-gathering supervisorate was abolished.
s0148.idiomatic: On yisi day the Xingzhou honey-gathering supervisorate was abolished.

s0149.literal: Granaries inside Shangdu city were built.
s0149.idiomatic: Granaries inside Shangdu city were built.

s0150.literal: On dingwei day spirit tablets were enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0150.idiomatic: On dingwei day spirit tablets were enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0151.literal: On wushen day Venus encroached upon Bi.
s0151.idiomatic: On wushen day Venus encroached upon Bi.

s0152.literal: Badubulun was granted one hundred fifty liang of gold, fifteen thousand liang of silver, and ten thousand bolts of silks, cloth, gauze, and damask.
s0152.idiomatic: Badubulun received 150 liang of gold, 15,000 liang of silver, and 10,000 bolts of silks, cloth, gauze, and damask.

s0153.literal: On xinhai day at Wuhe River in Meng Prefecture hail fell to five inches depth; the largest was fist-sized.
s0153.idiomatic: On xinhai day at Wuhe River in Meng Prefecture hail fell to five inches depth; the largest was fist-sized.

s0154.literal: On guichou day an edict ordered all within Huguang province to obey the command of grand councillors Tumad and Yaosumu.
s0154.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict placed all within Huguang province under the command of grand councillors Tumad and Yaosumu.

s0155.literal: Sichuan province's seat was moved to Chongqing; the pacification commission was moved back to Chengdu.
s0155.idiomatic: Sichuan province's seat was moved to Chongqing; the pacification commission was moved back to Chengdu.

s0156.literal: Goryeo dispatched envoys presenting local products as tribute.
s0156.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys presenting local products as tribute.

s0157.literal: An edict ordered all within Sichuan to obey the branch ministry secretariat's command.
s0157.idiomatic: An edict placed all within Sichuan under the branch ministry secretariat's command.

s0158.literal: The river broke its banks at Bianliang; Taikang, Tongxu, and Qi three counties and Chen and Ying two prefectures all suffered damage.
s0158.idiomatic: The river broke its banks at Bianliang; Taikang, Tongxu, and Qi three counties and Chen and Ying two prefectures all suffered damage.

s0159.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin day newly submitted troops were used to repair the Imperial Food Bureau.
s0159.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jiayin day newly submitted troops were used to repair the Imperial Food Bureau.

s0160.literal: On gengshen day famine victims among Prince Da'erbo's retainers and famine-stricken people of Guiyang Circuit were given relief.
s0160.idiomatic: On gengshen day famine victims among Prince Da'erbo's retainers and famine-stricken people of Guiyang Circuit were given relief.

s0161.literal: On xinyou day liquor was forbidden in Shangdu, Huanzhou, Yingchang, and Longxing.
s0161.idiomatic: On xinyou day liquor was forbidden in Shangdu, Huanzhou, Yingchang, and Longxing.

s0162.literal: On renxu day Prince Shibo was granted two hundred fifty liang each of gold and silver and ten thousand bolts of silks, cloth, gauze, and damask.
s0162.idiomatic: On renxu day Prince Shibo received 250 liang each of gold and silver and 10,000 bolts of silks, cloth, gauze, and damask.

s0163.literal: On yichou day an edict ordered Mongol commanders to take overall command of Han troops and drill in naval warfare.
s0163.idiomatic: On yichou day an edict ordered Mongol commanders to take overall command of Han troops and drill in naval warfare.

s0164.literal: On dingmao day Prince Shibo was again granted twenty-five thousand liang of silver and ten thousand bolts of silks, cloth, gauze, and damask.
s0164.idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince Shibo was again granted 25,000 liang of silver and 10,000 bolts of silks, cloth, gauze, and damask.

s0165.literal: Four relay stations from Xianping to Jianzhou were reestablished.
s0165.idiomatic: Four relay stations from Xianping to Jianzhou were reestablished.

s0166.literal: The Yan'an garrison-farm general administration office was again placed under Anxi province.
s0166.idiomatic: The Yan'an garrison-farm general administration office was again placed under Anxi province.

s0167.literal: On wuchen day Haidu's generals Ambak and Zhunuan led troops to invade Yeligan'ao'er; garrison commander Alidai fought them off.
s0167.idiomatic: On wuchen day Haidu's generals Ambak and Zhunuan led troops to invade Yeligan'ao'er; garrison commander Alidai fought them off.

s0168.literal: On renshen day Suiyang suffered torrential rain; the river overflowed and damaged crops; one thousand sixty odd shi of rent was remitted.
s0168.idiomatic: On renshen day Suiyang suffered torrential rain; the river overflowed and damaged crops; 1,060 odd shi of rent was remitted.

s0169.literal: Princes' qielian retainers and members of the imperial retinue were ordered to transport grain to provision the troops following the imperial grandson.
s0169.idiomatic: Princes' qielian retainers and members of the imperial retinue were ordered to transport grain to provision the troops following the imperial grandson.

s0170.literal: The Imperial Medical Academy, Court of Imperial Entertainments, Ceremonial Phoenix Bureau, Ceremonial Service, and Archery Guard were no longer subordinate to the Xuanwei Court; the Music Bureau was abolished and merged into the Archery Guard.
s0170.idiomatic: The Imperial Medical Academy, Court of Imperial Entertainments, Ceremonial Phoenix Bureau, Ceremonial Service, and Archery Guard were no longer subordinate to the Xuanwei Court; the Music Bureau was abolished and merged into the Archery Guard.

s0171.literal: On guiyou day an edict added the posthumous title Guangyou to the South Sea Heavenly Consort Mingzhu, making her Guangyou Mingzhu Heavenly Consort.
s0171.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict added the posthumous title Guangyou to the South Sea Heavenly Consort Mingzhu, making her Guangyou Mingzhu Heavenly Consort.

s0172.literal: On jiaxu day Venus encroached upon the Well.
s0172.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Venus encroached upon the Well.

s0173.literal: The Southwestern Barbarian general administration office was changed to Yongning Route.
s0173.idiomatic: The Southwestern Barbarian general administration office was changed to Yongning Route.

s0174.literal: On yihai day, because Kaocheng, Chenliu, Tongxu, Qi, and Taikang five counties suffered great floods and the river overflowed and submerged civilian fields, fifteen thousand two hundred shi of rent was remitted.
s0174.idiomatic: On yihai day, because Kaocheng, Chenliu, Tongxu, Qi, and Taikang five counties suffered great floods and the river overflowed and submerged civilian fields, 15,200 shi of rent was remitted.

s0175.literal: On bingzi day fifty troops were assigned to guard Zhexi pacification commissioner Shi Bi and empower him to take responsibility for suppressing bandits.
s0175.idiomatic: On bingzi day 50 troops were assigned to guard Zhexi pacification commissioner Shi Bi and empower him to take responsibility for suppressing bandits.

s0176.literal: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Jupiter.
s0176.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Jupiter.

s0177.literal: One thousand five hundred troops were dispatched to Hanbei to dredge wells.
s0177.idiomatic: 1,500 troops were dispatched to Hanbei to dredge wells.

s0178.literal: On guiwei day bandit Liu Shiying of Chuzhou raided Qingtian, Lishui, and other counties; Zhedong Circuit vice pacification commissioner Shi Yao suppressed them.
s0178.idiomatic: On guiwei day bandit Liu Shiying of Chuzhou raided Qingtian, Lishui, and other counties; Zhedong Circuit vice pacification commissioner Shi Yao suppressed them.

s0179.literal: Sixteen garrison colonies including Ziguo and Fuchang suffered rain, flood, and locust damage to crops.
s0179.idiomatic: Sixteen garrison colonies including Ziguo and Fuchang suffered rain, flood, and locust damage to crops.

s0180.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on jiashen new moon, granaries of Xing and Ling prefectures were repaired; Sibaozhi, Helazhi, Guiyouzhi, and left and right guards were first ordered to transport grain to them; provincial officials were entrusted to supervise transport to prepare for relief distribution.
s0180.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on the jiashen new moon, granaries of Xing and Ling prefectures were repaired; Sibaozhi, Helazhi, Guiyouzhi, and the left and right guards were first ordered to transport grain to them; provincial officials were entrusted to supervise transport to prepare for relief distribution.

s0181.literal: On bingxu day Zhending and Bianliang routes suffered locusts.
s0181.idiomatic: On bingxu day Zhending and Bianliang routes suffered locusts.

s0182.literal: Grain from the various granaries of Datong and Taiyuan was transported to Xincheng as frontier reserves.
s0182.idiomatic: Grain from the various granaries of Datong and Taiyuan was transported to Xincheng as frontier reserves.

s0183.literal: Because bandits had risen year after year in Nan'an, Rui, and Gan three routes and many people had lost their livelihoods, twelve thousand six hundred odd shi of overdue taxes was remitted.
s0183.idiomatic: Because bandits had risen year after year in Nan'an, Rui, and Gan three routes and many people had lost their livelihoods, 12,600 odd shi of overdue taxes was remitted.

s0184.literal: The liquor prohibition in Ningxia was relaxed.
s0184.idiomatic: The liquor prohibition in Ningxia was relaxed.

s0185.literal: Grain from Datong Circuit was dispatched to relieve displaced people.
s0185.idiomatic: Grain from Datong Circuit was dispatched to relieve displaced people.

s0186.literal: Baoding Circuit suffered torrential rain damaging crops; this year's field rent was remitted.
s0186.idiomatic: Baoding Circuit suffered torrential rain damaging crops; this year's field rent was remitted.

s0187.literal: The Reserve Storage Office was changed to a supervisorate.
s0187.idiomatic: The Reserve Storage Office was changed to a supervisorate.

s0188.literal: An edict ordered officers on the Jiaozhi campaign home for one year's rest.
s0188.idiomatic: An edict ordered officers on the Jiaozhi campaign home for one year's rest.

s0189.literal: On renchen day couriers were dispatched with five thousand ingots of notes to Yingchang for equitable purchase of army provisions.
s0189.idiomatic: On renchen day couriers were dispatched with 5,000 ingots of notes to Yingchang for equitable purchase of army provisions.

s0190.literal: The Hall of Joint Audience was changed to the Four Guest Storehouses.
s0190.idiomatic: The Hall of Joint Audience was changed to the Four Guest Storehouses.

s0191.literal: On wuxu day the imperial procession halted at Xunibaiya.
s0191.idiomatic: On wuxu day the imperial procession halted at Xunibaiya.

s0192.literal: Acting Jiangxi branch privy council vice director Yuedimishi memorialized: "Recently, because bandits rose in Guangdong, ten thousand troops from Jiangxi, Jiang-Huai, and Fujian three provinces were divided and placed under my command to suppress the bandits.
s0192.idiomatic: Acting Jiangxi branch privy council vice director Yuedimishi memorialized, "Recently, because bandits rose in Guangdong, 10,000 troops from Jiangxi, Jiang-Huai, and Fujian three provinces were divided and placed under my command to suppress the bandits.

s0193.literal: I ask that among the ten thousand troops I receive three hundred Mongol troops, and together with the ten thousand surrendered households under my register I establish a myriarch office, with Samughur as darughachi bearing a tiger tally.
s0193.idiomatic: I ask that among the 10,000 troops I receive 300 Mongol troops, and together with the 10,000 surrendered households under my register I establish a myriarch office, with Samughur as darughachi bearing a tiger tally.

s0195.literal: The five stockades including Muchuan that had been cut off from Jiading and placed under subordination were returned to the Muhu Man Tribal General Administration Office.
s0195.idiomatic: The five stockades including Muchuan that had been cut off from Jiading and placed under subordination were returned to the Muhu Man Tribal General Administration Office.

s0196.literal: On jihai day Mars encroached upon Di.
s0196.idiomatic: On jihai day Mars encroached upon Di.

s0197.literal: On gengzi day Venus encroached upon Ghost.
s0197.idiomatic: On gengzi day Venus encroached upon Ghost.

s0198.literal: Jiaozhou suffered great floods year after year; the people gathered acorns for food; an edict ordered grain sold at reduced prices to relieve them.
s0198.idiomatic: Jiaozhou suffered great floods year after year; the people gathered acorns for food; an edict ordered grain sold at reduced prices to relieve them.

s0199.literal: Ba and Huo prefectures suffered torrential rain damaging crops; this year's field rent was remitted.
s0199.idiomatic: Ba and Huo prefectures suffered torrential rain damaging crops; this year's field rent was remitted.

s0200.literal: On yisi day the moon eclipsed Bi.
s0200.idiomatic: On yisi day the moon eclipsed Bi.
